title: 配置融聚汇MCP服务
description: 连接您的融聚汇MCP，用于查询股票、债券、期权、基金、宏观数据。凭证仅存储在本机 ~/.workbuddy 目录下。
description_en: Connect your FIU MCP. Credentials are stored locally only.
docLabel: 前往融聚汇FIU MCP官网获取令牌
docLabel_en: Get a Token from the FIU MCP website

fields.label: 令牌
fields.placeholder: 粘贴令牌本身，不包含 Bearer 前缀
fields.placeholder_en: Paste the Token without the Bearer prefix
fields.description: 用于访问融聚汇MCP服务。仅填写令牌本身，不包含 Bearer 前缀或引号；凭证由 WorkBuddy 保存在本机并注入请求头。
fields.description_en: Enter only the Token, without a Bearer prefix or quotes. WorkBuddy stores it locally and injects it into the request header.
